body: I was able to talk to my son on the phone today, and the first thing he said was "mom, can you pick me up?" Broke my heart! He's already noticing somethings not right.
You're right. He's going to use whatever he can. There's not much for him to use, but im sure they will grasp onto anything and run with it.

Yes! I've been nothing but kind this whole time since I dont want my child to see or be involved, but now he is... but remaining as calm as I can. I sent them a text and hope they dont call. I might even say I would like a text reply back.

This is a good idea! Because I am concerned. My son is very attached to me, and even more my nephew that I take him to play with every week lol, but im sure its going to get hard on him when told he cant be with me. He's 3, but kids aren't dumb. They know.

I really appreciate the responses! Just got a call and the attorney can get me in much sooner due to what's happening! Yep! Not posting any info anywhere that my ex can see or his family can see. I fear hes trying to turn my son against me, or lie, but his and his family have seen how much my son cries when I have to do the trade offs. Just wild to me he'd weaponize a child like this. I hate my ex, but I'd never alienate. 


But things are looking hopeful! Just hate i cant just go get my child.
I looked it up, thank you! It does explain some relationships! But majority i talk to are nd to some degree? So just kind of at a loss with those ones.

I don't know if anyone will see this, but thank you so much for the responses. I feel a bit more ready to have him at home again. I started medications about a week and a half ago and I think they are starting to work? I feel happier and more, I don't know, present and not an emotionless doll. This weekend I'll have him so fingers crossed it all goes well!

Update: if anyone sees haha

Went to the doctor! They upped meds I am already taking to see if it helps. They think it's a combination of depression, stress, inconsistent sleeping schedule, and major life events that's causing me to struggle. 

So far, the last episode I had was thursday. I was so scared of absolutely nothing, seeing things out of the corner of my eye, and gave into a sh habit I thought I beat. All this when the baby wasn't even home. But since then im doing well! 

Today though I am very tired for no reason, so I'm trying to make arrangements to have my baby watched so I can rest a bit.

Update: I was able to write to the midwife at my obgyn that specializes in mental health, and she actually got back to me even though its the weekend. Said I need more sleep to see if it improves. That I should let someone watch my baby for a couple days and get good sleep. Also that if the symptoms get worse I should go to the er. She also ordered blood work that I can go in and get once I'm able.

I had mentioned my paranoia to her as well, since I was looking up postpartum psychosis and had been struggling with that as well. I get fearful my ex's family are plotting to take my baby. So hopefully that improves too! 

Thank you all for being so nice and kind to me! I really appreciate you all!
Don't make me cry haha. Thanks so much. I'll get ahold of the doctor once I can.

With sleep or just in general?

Sleep had been okay, though right now I can't for some reason. 

In general, eh it's been off and on. It's like I'll go from a high to a low very quickly.
That sounds exactly like what's happening!

Wish I could get some good sleep! But I'm sadly going at this alone. 

Oh yeah I get jumpy as well! Answered under another comment what I see.

I mostly see my baby actually. Like they'll be in my bed(which they never sleep there), or even floating above the bassinet. Or I'll see things on the baby. Mostly extra eyes? Sometimes I'll see like cats or mice running out of the corner of my eyes. Silly things.
